mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.student_id) FROM student_course sc WHERE sc.course_id = #{courseId} AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM diagnostic_session ds WHERE ds.student_id = sc.student_id AND ds.course_id = sc.course_id AND ds.status = 1 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM adaptive_diag_session ads WHERE ads.student_id = sc.student_id AND ads.course_id = sc.course_id AND ads.status = 1 ) )

SELECT sm.id, sm.student_id, sm.course_id, sm.node_id, sm.mastery_score, sm.mastery_level, sm.updated_at FROM student_course sc LEFT JOIN kg_node n ON n.course_id = sc.course_id AND n.archived_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN student_mastery sm ON sm.student_id = sc.student_id AND sm.course_id = sc.course_id AND sm.node_id = n.id WHERE sc.course_id = #{courseId} AND sm.id IS NOT NULL
